extras.approval_status: APPROVED by project owner 2026-08-04, per plan.md decision D7. lo_limit/n_dims accepted as untuned defaults for now — may be revisited once real output is inspected; that revisit does not require another D7 sign-off since it's a technical tuning choice, not a factual claim about Praha's assembly.
extras.vocabulary_and_thresholds: yes/no/abstain/absent/not-voting grouping mirrors cz-psp-data-2025-202x's wpca_definition.json convention (abstain grouped with 'no' for ideological-direction purposes, not treated as neutral; lo_limit=0.1 and n_dims=3 copied as reasonable defaults from that same reference file, not independently tuned for Praha's ~65-member assembly — owner/analyst may want to revisit these two values once real output is inspected).
extras.rotate_choice: praha:person:bohuslav-svoboda (primátor, SPOLU pro Prahu) chosen as the PCA rotation anchor only to fix the sign/orientation of the output axes for readability — an arbitrary technical choice (any consistently-voting member works), not a factual claim requiring citation.
extras.government_axis_override_note: Which dims[] index correlates with real government/opposition membership emerges from the voting data — it is NOT fixed, and is detected automatically by praha/scripts/detect_government_axis.py via point-biserial correlation against government_groups (praha/analyses/govity/govity_definition.json), written to the sidecar praha/analyses/wpca/outputs/government_axis.json. If auto-detection ever picks the wrong dimension (e.g. after a coalition change makes a different dimension the cleaner separator), set this field to the desired 0-based dims[] index (0, 1, or 2) to force it; leave null to keep using automatic detection. For the term starting 2022-11-03, auto-detection correctly picks index 1 (dims[1], i.e. the second dimension) — no override is needed.
extras.rotate_sign_confirmation: Re-verified 2026-08-05 (see praha/analyses/wpca/outputs/government_axis.json). The existing rotate anchor (praha:person:bohuslav-svoboda, SPOLU pro Prahu, a government-coalition member) already happens to put government positive on the detected government axis (dims[1]): government_mean=+0.33, opposition_mean=-0.47, government_sign=+1. No sign-flip on top of the existing rotate config is needed for this term. This is a data fact, not a rotate config setting — it is not guaranteed to still hold after a future coalition change or re-run; detect_government_axis.py's government_sign field should be re-checked (not assumed) whenever wpca.json is regenerated.
